fixes.title: Reachability Cache Invalidation
fixes.issue: add_edge() did not clear cache, causing stale reachability answers (CRITICAL)
fixes.solution: Clear cache on every mutation; convert recursive DFS to iterative BFS

fixes.title: Improved Contradiction Detection
fixes.solution: Semantic similarity check + negation pattern matching + semantic opposites
fixes.integration: Now live in calculate_confidence() for knowledge graph

fixes.title: Batched Edge Insert (N+1 Elimination)
fixes.issue: record_visible_field() looped with single INSERT per edge (N+1 query problem)
fixes.solution: UNNEST-based batch insert for all edges in one round-trip
